Description

Paste a recipe link, and the whole recipe lands in your own beautiful library: ingredients, steps, times, servings and photo, without the ads or the life story.

Recipe Library Studio is a recipe keeper, meal planner and shopping list in one calm app. It runs in your web browser on your computer, tablet or phone, and you can install it like an app. Your recipes stay private on your own device, with one-click backups you keep.

How It Works:
1. Download the PDF in your Etsy order and open your Recipe Library Studio link.
2. Paste a recipe link from your favorite site, or paste up to 100 links at once.
3. Plan your week, send the ingredients to your shopping list, and start cooking.

WHAT YOU'LL GET:
• Recipe Library Studio web app with instant access, installable on phone and computer
• Import from a link: ingredients, steps, times, servings, nutrition and photo
• Bulk import: paste up to 100 links and they are saved one by one
• Paste the page: for sites that block apps, copy the page and paste it in
• 20 tested recipe sites that import in one step, including HelloFresh, BBC Good Food, Taste of Home, King Arthur Baking, Tasty, RecipeTin Eats and Pinch of Yum
• Check a website: test any recipe site before you rely on it
• Weekly meal planner with servings, drag and drop, Fill my week and Copy last week
• Smart shopping list sorted by aisle, with staples, scaling and one-tap copy
• Pantry with What can I cook: see what you can make with what you have
• Cook mode with large steps and built-in timers
• Serving scaler plus US and metric conversion
• Cook log: rate each recipe and keep notes every time you make it
• Collections, categories and tags, all editable
• Print-ready recipe cards, shopping lists and meal plans in Letter or A4
• Recipe book PDF with a designer cover and contents page
• 8 color themes, including two dark modes
• Backups that merge without duplicates, plus CSV export
• Sample recipes to explore and a short welcome tour

PERFECT FOR:
Home cooks with recipes scattered across bookmarks, screenshots and Pinterest boards, busy families who plan dinners for the week, meal preppers, bakers building a collection, anyone saving family recipes, and anyone who loves a tidy kitchen system. It also makes a thoughtful gift for a new home, a wedding or a first apartment.

GOOD TO KNOW:
• Most food blogs and recipe sites import from a link. A few large sites block automatic import (for example Allrecipes and NYT Cooking); for those, copy the recipe page and paste it, which takes a few seconds. The app lists which sites work.
• Your library is saved in your browser on each device. Download a backup to move it to another device or to keep it safe.
• Works in Chrome, Edge, Safari and Firefox on Mac, Windows, iPhone, iPad and Android. An internet connection is needed to import from links.
